name: Hesk
hail: [a slow gold pulse] We see you. Speak in light.
[gold, flash, gold] Hesk greets you. Radio is rude. We forgive it once.
[blue rings, opening] Out of the long night, Hesk shows itself.
close: [amber, then dark] Until the next light.
finding: [clear lines across the skin] We see it so: {part}
sighting: In the long night, we watched: {part}
archive: [slow patterns, layered] From the Lit Halls: {part}
[a long scroll of color] Our record: {part}
[soft green, unfolding] We show what we kept: {part}
culture: [a slow pattern, proud] We are this: {part}
request: {part} Answer in light, if you can.
verdict: After a long night of looking: {part}
